description: Item icons, rarity frames and the tooltip panel of the inventory grid.
style: Painted fantasy game UI: clean silhouettes, a dark outline, soft two-tone shading, light from the top left, saturated but not neon colors. No text, logos or watermarks.

items.subject: Iron sword with a leather-wrapped grip, diagonal from bottom left to top right
Slot frame for epic items: purple metal border with small engraved corners and a transparent middle
Tooltip background: dark blue-grey panel with a thin light rim
items.usedBy: /Game/UI/Components/WBP_Tooltip: widget Background, property Background (DrawAs Box, Margin 0.125)
items.feedback: The rim is thicker on the left than on the right, so the panel looks shifted when it stretches. Keep the rim 4 px wide on every side.
